description: Awarding the Consultancy Contract for Construction Supervision of Phase II of the Anuradhapura North Water Supply Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-02-23 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been designed to supply safe drinking water to the residents in the Padaviya, Kahatagasdigiliya, Kebithigollewa, Horowpathana Divisional Secretariat Divisions and to the residents in a part of the Rambewa and Medawachchiya Divisional Secretariat Divisions from the Yan Oya Reservoir under Phase II of the Anuradhapura North Water Supply Project, being implemented with the funds of the Government of Sri Lanka and the Japan International Cooperation Agency. Proposals have been invited from 06 Japanese consultancy firms shortlisted by the Japan International Cooperation Agency, using the Quality and Cost-Based Selection method in accordance with the Japanese ODA Loan Guidelines to select a consultant for the construction supervision of the said project. Two (02) firms have submitted Proposals. Based on the recommendations submitted by the Cabinet Appointed Consultants Procurement Committee upon the evaluation of the technical and financial proposals of the said proposals, the Cabinet approved the proposal made by the Minister of Housing, Construction and Water Supply to award the said consultancy contract to M/s. Nippon Koei Pvt Ltd, a joint venture with M/s. Nippon Koei India Pvt Ltd of India and Green Tech Consultants Pvt Ltd. of Sri Lanka, for a sum of Japanese Yen 82.39 million and Rs.332.01 million (excluding tax), was approved by the Cabinet.
